cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put a star beside Friday, so I've added two beside Saturday. Is this how we're choosing the picnic day?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The star means read the note. The picnic's on Friday now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the note. Is that your blue pen it's written in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I moved it because I'm working Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That explains it. Who's telling the guests who booked Saturday off? Shall I put their names under your note?

reason: Use concrete copied misunderstandings to shape control, quiet restoration, detail diversion, protective handling or inquiry, with each B contribution changing A's next move.
